title: Cardiac Septal Hypertrophy in the Fetus of Diabetic Mother and Its Effect on Postnatal Cardiac Function
brief_summary: Good glycemic control is superior to poor glycemic control in reducing risk of interventricular septum thickness among fetuses of diabetic mothers
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* singleton pregnancy
* gestational age 36 weeks

Exclusion Criteria:

* congenital anomalies
* obstetric complications
* medical disorders other than diabetes
study_population: diabetic pregnant ladies gestational age more than 35 weeks
condition: Cardiology in Fetus of Diabetic Mother
